title: Add Graceful Shutdown & Health‑Check Endpoint
description: Provides a /health endpoint that reports service status and integrates a graceful shutdown sequence for SIGINT/SIGTERM. This improves observability in production and prevents abrupt termination of in‑flight requests, reducing error spikes during deployments.
testCases: Verify GET /health returns 200 with {status:"ok"} and uptime in seconds
Simulate SIGTERM, ensure server stops accepting new connections, finishes ongoing requests, and logs shutdown complete
acceptance: A GET request to /health returns a JSON payload with status "ok" and a numeric uptime; when the process receives SIGINT or SIGTERM the server stops accepting new connections, waits up to 10 seconds for active requests to finish, then exits with code 0 and logs a shutdown message.
reason: Production deployments need reliable health monitoring and clean termination to avoid dropped requests and to satisfy orchestrators (K8s, Docker). Implementing this now eliminates a common source of downtime and aligns yantraverse with modern DevOps practices.
